input.summary: Reverse Deliverable ownership: Vendor assigns Deliverables to Customer, retaining Vendor Technology under 14.3.
input.comment: [Playbook] We own the work product we pay for, so we have flipped Section 14.2 so Vendor assigns each Deliverable to us; Vendor's pre-existing Vendor Technology is unaffected and remains protected by Sections 14.3 and 13.2. If Vendor must retain title, our fallback is a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free licence to use, modify and sublicense the Deliverables for our business, in place of the current revocable, term-limited licence.

ops.oldText: 14.2 Vendor exclusively owns every Deliverable created for Customer. Customer receives a revocable, non-transferable licence to use a Deliverable only during the applicable Order Form term.
ops.newText: 14.2 Customer exclusively owns every Deliverable created for Customer, and Vendor hereby irrevocably assigns to Customer all right, title, and interest in and to each Deliverable upon creation. Vendor retains Vendor Technology in accordance with Section 14.3.
